infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Use Face ID to sign in quickly to your assigned route.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Used to show your bus position on the route map while the app is open.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Used to continue sending your bus's location to dispatch when the iPad is locked, so the school can track the route in real time.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Rihla Driver to track your route location, including when the app is in the background, so dispatch can follow the bus in real time.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Rihla Driver to show your position on the route map while the app is open.
